final: WITH eligible AS (SELECT p.ID FROM Patient AS p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l."U-PRO" = '-') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.RA = '-')), per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN eligible AS e ON e.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_of_patient_pt_averages, AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS avg_of_patient_tat_minus_tat2_averages FROM per_patient
